claude.rationale: The slice states the institutions were acquired "as going concerns, each retaining its accreditations, trademarks, campuses and local operations," and that for BPP "the customer-facing product, its delivering operations and its organization transferred together as an intact institution," so product (T4) and its producing processes (T5) crossed together — gap_45 = 0. Likewise the delivering operations and organization/people transferred as one intact institution run as its own reportable segment, so processes (T5) and organization (T6) moved coherently together — gap_56 = 0. T1 is coded imprint-share because two principals (Apollo Group controlling, Carlyle minority financial partner) jointly formed the vehicle with both intents co-present. Since no gap is coded, gap_mitigated = NA, consistent with the filing noting no transitional-services or shared-substrate agreement (the institutions are self-standing segments).

No transitional-services or shared-substrate bridging agreement is described; gaps are absent, so mitigation is NA.
